summary: Boundary County log cabin lookout on a 7,670-foot peak, built 1937 and abandoned in the 1960s; listed as gone, with no source describing the site now.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source we read describes what remains.

access.note: Reached on foot on Kaniksu National Forest land; a trail guide describes the route from the West Side Road.

visit.trail_note: Hike-in; the trail guide gives more than 5,820 feet of climbing from the West Side Road trailhead.

events.note: Jesse Daniels, the only lookout personnel either site names; dated a year before the 1937 build date
Sources give only the 1960s; 1960 is carried over from the record
Trail guide says there used to be a fire lookout on the summit

evidence.supports: log cabin built 1937; abandoned in the 1960s
about ten miles southwest of Porthill, Boundary County
Jesse Daniels listed as known lookout personnel in 1936
log cabin on the Idaho site
built 1937, log cabin, on the Idaho site
abandoned in the 1960s on the Idaho site
Jesse Daniels the only name under Known Staff, dated 1936
Jesse Daniels service record at Parker Peak Lookout in 1936
a fire lookout used to stand on the summit, per 1939 mention
evidence.quote: In 1939 there used to be a fire lookout on top of Parker Peak, the second highest peak in North Idaho.

evidence.supports: more than 5,820 feet of climbing from the West Side Road to the summit
evidence.quote: From the trailhead on the West Side Road to the summit of Parker Peak, is more than 5820' in elevation gain.

corrections.why: firelookout.com gives Abandoned 1960s and the Idaho site also gives the 1960s; neither gives a single year.

notes_for_editor: The 1936 staffing date comes before the 1937 build date both sites give; no source we read reconciles them. The record's 1960 is decade-only (see corrections). Status gone comes from the FFLA list; the Idaho site gives Abandoned with a 1960s date and no later status. No source describes remains. No new photos found.
